#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const double PI = acos(-1.0);

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    if (n >= 100) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    vector<int> a(105), b(105), c(105), d(105), e(105);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i] >> b[i] >> c[i] >> d[i] >> e[i];
    }

    set<int> bad;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
                if (i == j || j == k || k == i) continue;

                long long ax = a[j] - a[i];
                long long bx = b[j] - b[i];
                long long cx = c[j] - c[i];
                long long dx = d[j] - d[i];
                long long ex = e[j] - e[i];

                long long ay = a[k] - a[i];
                long long by = b[k] - b[i];
                long long cy = c[k] - c[i];
                long long dy = d[k] - d[i];
                long long ey = e[k] - e[i];

                double val = ax * ay + bx * by + cx * cy + dx * dy + ex * ey;
                long long m1 = ax * ax + bx * bx + cx * cx + dx * dx + ex * ex;
                long long m2 = ay * ay + by * by + cy * cy + dy * dy + ey * ey;
                val = val / sqrt((double)m1);
                val = val / sqrt((double)m2);
                double angle = acos(val) * 180.0 / PI;
                if (angle + 1e-9 < 90.0) {
                    bad.insert(i);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << n - bad.size() << endl;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (bad.find(i) == bad.end()) {
            cout << i << endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
